scenicChapters.title: Seven Passes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 55 km this is Seven Passes Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

road-garden-route.story: A 417 km round trip from Mossel Bay - roughly 6 h 57 in the saddle. On the way it passes Wilderness, Knysna, Plettenberg Bay and Storms River. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 40 km this is Romantic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-fort-site-and-civil-settlement-of.story: 299 km from Weißenburg in Bayern to Weißenburg in Bayern, about 5 h 09 of riding. It goes by way of Limessection between watchtowers WP 13/40, Watchtowers WP 12/86 to 13/5 including for, Watchtowers WP 12/40 to 12/59 and Watchtowers WP 9/101 to 9/131 including th. The line favours views over speed.
